name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (gfx/blit domain). Descriptor accurately reflects body: paints a rectangular sprite by chaining the per-pixel run decoder fd2_decode_dialog_pixel_byte and skipping zero (transparent) pixels. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no domain ID involved.
purpose: Paint a rectangular sprite from the dialog-pixel run-encoded stream into a destination buffer, skipping zero (transparent) pixels.
logic_summary: Reads col_count = *(uint16*)sprite_hdr and row_count = *(uint16*)(sprite_hdr+2); cursor starts at sprite_hdr+4; decode state seeded to 0 once. Outer post-test row loop (DEC DX; JNZ, count=row_count): dst_row=dst, inner post-test col loop (LOOP on CX, count=col_count) calls fd2_decode_dialog_pixel_byte(state) per pixel, feeding the returned packed (run_remain<<8)|pixel back as next state and advancing the shared stream cursor 0/1/2 bytes; writes the low byte to *dst_row only when non-zero (zero=transparent), then dst_row++. After each row dst += stride. Body wrapped in PUSHAD/POPAD with a plain RET, so EAX is unchanged (decompiler 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact) and every call site discards it -> effectively void.
signature: void fd2_blit_sprite_with_decoded_pixels(uint32 dst, uint32 sprite_hdr, uint32 stride)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (row base); advanced by stride per row [EDI from EBP+8].
params.reason: Accurate, descriptive, no address residue; matches caller (resolved screen/buffer address) and body usage.

params.name: sprite_hdr
params.semantics: Sprite header pointer [ESI from EBP+0xC]: ushort width @+0 (cols per row), ushort height @+2 (rows), then the encoded pixel byte stream at +4.
params.reason: Accurate, descriptive, no address residue; matches caller (resolved portrait/atlas sprite address) and the two LODSW header reads.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Bytes to advance dst per destination row [EBX from EBP+0x10].
params.reason: Accurate, descriptive, no address residue; matches caller (e.g. 0x1c8) and the ADD EDI,EBX per-row advance.

returns.semantics: No meaningful return. Binary leaves EAX at its entry value (PUSHAD/POPAD wrap, plain RET); decompiler's 'return in_EAX' is a passthrough artifact and all 9 call sites discard it.

notes: Source comment block (blitspr.c lines 1456-1500) and Ghidra plate are both accurate and consistent with the decompiled logic and the verified disassembly (PUSH EBP/PUSHAD prologue; LODSW->BP col_count, LODSW->DX row_count; XOR ECX,ECX + XOR AX,AX; PUSH EDI/MOV CX,BP; CALL 0x4e916; OR AL,AL/JZ skip-zero; MOV [EDI],AL; INC EDI; LOOP; POP EDI/ADD EDI,EBX; DEC DX/JNZ; POPAD/POP EBP/RET). No edit needed to either. Callers confirm dst/sprite_hdr/stride semantics and discarded return; representative caller fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target @ 0x1c4cc passes (screen addr, resolved portrait sprite addr, 0x1c8). 9 call sites total. Per-pixel decoder is fd2_decode_dialog_pixel_byte @ 0x4e916.
